name: Priority Queue MIP with Min/Max Grids
aliases: Maximum Intensity Projection (MIP) with Priority Queue
definition: A MIP technique using a priority queue and min/max multilevel grids to efficiently find the maximum value along a ray.
summary: Priority Queue MIP with Min/Max Grids is an image-order ray casting technique that efficiently computes Maximum Intensity Projection by using a hierarchical min/max grid to prune traversal and skip low-intensity regions.
